figures.title: Decision tree: BACnet device offline in the BMS (BACnet/IP and MS/TP)
figures.caption: Worked example on trunk B2-DH3-MSTP-02: devices at MAC 70 and 72 never got the token because Max Master was 64; setting 127 brought both online in 1 minute.

verify: A device whose MAC is above the Max Master value of the other masters is never polled; Max Master is set at least equal to the highest MAC on the trunk.

figures.title: Decision tree: meter reads a wrong value (power, current or energy)
figures.caption: Worked example: B2-ER-A1-PM8000-07 showed 286 kW at a 1,430 kW load bank; the meter was set to 4000/5 A on a 4000/1 A CT, so it read one fifth of the load.

verify: 1,430 kW / 5 = 286 kW: a factor of exactly 5 on every phase proves a CT secondary rating error (5 A against 1 A).

figures.title: Decision tree: generator fails to synchronise to the 20 kV generator bus
figures.caption: A constant angle error with near-zero slip points to wiring (rotation or VT connection); a moving angle that never settles points to the governor or the slip window.
